beats.text: Each year, a panel of residents investigates City government and makes recommendations.
Departments must answer. The Controller follows up yearly.
Across 16 reports, departments promised 77 times to carry out a recommendation.

beats.text: The most: the Mayor, 10. The Superintendent of Schools, 4. The Office of the Mayor, 3.
A department that says it will act isn’t asked again for a year.
